title: Creamy American Pasta Bake
description: A comforting pasta dish with a rich and creamy sauce, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This bake is easy to make and feeds a crowd.
instructions: Cook the pasta according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a medium saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the flour and whisk to combine. Cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Slowly pour in the milk, whisking constantly to avoid lumps. Bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and add the cream cheese. Stir until melted and smooth.
Stir in the parmesan cheese, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cooked pasta to the cheese sauce and stir until well combined.
Transfer the pasta mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Top with additional parmesan cheese if desired.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the sauce is bubbly.
